verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API, so streaming interim versus final results is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only shows a batch job option that streams progress and chronological segments over SSE. Nothing documents interim or partial hypotheses being marked separately from final transcripts, or any finality semantics, so the SSE feature is adjacent rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, streaming results distinguish interim from final transcripts, with the finality semantics documented

citations.quote: When enabled, streams progress and chronological transcription segments using SSE.
